mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, status, start_date, end_date FROM project ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'ACTIVE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, id DESC
SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.name, u.role, pm.project_role FROM project_member pm JOIN users u ON u.id = pm.user_id WHERE pm.project_id = #{projectId} AND u.enabled = TRUE ORDER BY u.name
